critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_plot_report_data computes total_payable as sum of payment schedule amounts, falling back to final_price/total only when there is no schedule — matches the user's contract.

sell_unit and edit_schedule both enforce abs(sched_total - grand_total) > 1 rupee -> 400 with clear message; the tolerance of 1 rupee is reasonable but note the frontend uses Math.abs(gap) < 1 with the same tolerance (Sales.jsx line 627), keeping UI and API consistent.

Frontend ScheduleEditor.disable = busy || (grandTotal > 0 && !matches). If a project has 0 charge columns (grandTotal=0), the Save button is not gated — this mirrors backend's `if _gt > 0` guard. OK but consider whether such projects should exist.
Existing guardrails (verified-amount floor, non-empty-receipt removal) remain intact in edit_schedule — not re-tested here since they were validated previously.
